verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows assigning a conversation to a teammate or routing incoming mail to a specific owner. The closest features are team comments, where an @mention shares the email with a teammate, and plain-English AI filters that label, star or archive mail. Both are adjacent features that do not make ownership explicit. Community comments also note Shortwave lacks Front-style team or multi-inbox features.

support.subject: As a team-lead, I can assign conversations to teammates and route incoming mail with rules so ownership is explicit
